stem: Why should a month's CPC be total spend / total clicks rather than the average of the 30 daily CPCs?

options.text: A quiet day with few clicks would weigh as much as a busy day with many
The average of daily CPCs always comes out higher than the monthly CPC
Total spend / total clicks gives the median price of a click, not the mean
The average would be right only if every day had the same ad spend
